title: Mison: A Fast JSON Parser for Data Analytics
relevance: Pioneered converting control flow (FSM parsing) into data flow (structural indices), enabling branchless parsing and SIMD parallelism.

title: PipeJSON: Parsing JSON at Line Speed on FPGAs
relevance: Demonstrates pipelined JSON parsing on FPGAs, achieving 7.95x speedup over CPU parsers, validating the dataflow pipeline approach.

title: cuJSON: A Highly Parallel JSON Parser for GPUs
relevance: GPU-parallel JSON parsing using structural index construction as a dataflow pipeline, showing the architecture scales to massive parallelism.

title: Exploiting SIMD-ified Bit-Parallelism for High-Performance Complex Event Matching
relevance: Uses bit-parallel dataflow for event matching, achieving 35.7x improvement -- validates the FSM-to-dataflow transformation for pattern matching workloads.
